properties.label_detail_en: Shendi was a large commercial centre under the autonomous rule of the Sa'dab Ja'aliyyin when Bruce visited in 1773; late in the Funj period the Sa'dab became virtually autonomous of the 'Abdallab.

properties.to_note: Wikidata's English label reads 'Sengs' (an error on Wikidata); the Arabic label سنار and description 'Town in Sennar State, Sudan' match. Display 'Sennar'; we do not edit Wikidata.
properties.label_en: The 'Abdallab ruled indirectly over the Nile-valley chieftaincies as Funj vassals; later the Sa'dab of Shendi became virtually autonomous.
properties.label_ar: حكم العبدلاب، بوصفهم أتباعاً للفونج، مشيخات وادي النيل حكماً غير مباشر، ثم صار السعداب في شندي شبه مستقلين. [Arabic text pending native-speaker review.]
